cs.t: My iPhone 13 Mini is just a touch too big for my taste. For phones I've owned, I'd probably give the nod to the HTC Incredible 4G LTE[1]. Relatively stock Android, 4" screen, headphone jack, soft touch plastic back. It was perfect. [1]  https://www.phonescoop.com/phones/phone.php?p=3701

I've loaded Cyanogenmod on the HTC Incredible 1 & 2, and the BN Nook color. I've loaded Lineage on the Nexus 6, Oneplus 3a & 5 & Nord N200, the original Pixel, and the Pixel 3a XL. Pixels are the most forgiving, and the hardest to brick. They are also the best for VoLTE. I also have an N100, which is not supported by Lineage.
cs.th: Google Pixel 4a's old firmware is gone, trapping users on buggy battery update
